articles.summary: Bank Director's RankingBanking underscores Republic's consistent performance, disciplined growth, and client-first philosophy Republic Bancorp, Inc., parent company of Republic Bank Trust Company (“Republic” or the “Bank”), has been recognized once again as a Top 25 Publicly Traded Bank in Bank Director's RankingBanking Report, an annual evaluation of the nation's top-performing publicly traded banking institutions. "Earning a Top 25 ranking for the second consecutive year is a meaningful reflection of the consistency and discipline that have long defined Republic Bank," said Republic Bancorp Executive Chair Steve Trager. "We remain focused on serving clients, strengthening our communities, and executing on a strategy designed to create lasting value. We are proud to see those efforts recognized on a national stage." RankingBanking is Bank Director's annual analysis of the 300 largest publicly traded banks in the United States. The 2026 ranking, based on year-end 2025 results,
articles.title: Republic Bank Recognized as a Top 25 Publicly Traded Bank for Second Straight Year
